pictures.scene: Kramskoi, Christ in the Wilderness — a man sitting alone on grey broken stones in a cold stony waste at daybreak, a dark green mantle pulled over a deep red robe, his bare feet on the rock and his hands locked hard together between his knees, his eyes fixed on nothing in front of him, and a thin band of pink light lying along the far horizon, then jesus was led by the spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil, after fasting forty days and forty nights, he was hungry
pictures.name: pd_kramskoi_christ_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: Melendez, Still Life with Figs and Bread — two round country loaves lying on a bare wooden table with one of them cut open, a white dish heaped with green and purple figs beside them, a dark corked bottle and a wooden cooler standing behind, and a knife left across the board, with no person anywhere in the picture, the tempter came to him and said, if you are the son of god, tell these stones to become bread, but jesus answered, it is written, man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of god
pictures.name: pd_melendez_figs_and_bread

pictures.scene: Church, Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives — the walled holy city lying pale gold along its ridge under a great reach of broken cloud, the domed temple platform standing clear above the long wall, olive trees scattered down the dry slope, and a camel and three small travellers halted on the stony path in the foreground, then the devil took him to the holy city and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, if you are the son of god, he said, throw yourself down, for it is written, he will command his angels concerning you, and they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone
pictures.name: pd_church_jerusalem_from_the_mount_of_olives

pictures.scene: Calame, Mountain — a great pale cliff standing up out of dark pine woods with a far higher crag showing through torn storm cloud above it, grey rain hanging across the whole sky, and a stream breaking white over boulders in the gorge below, with no person anywhere in it, jesus replied, it is also written, do not put the lord your god to the test, again, the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory
pictures.name: pd_calame_montagne

pictures.scene: Christus, A Goldsmith in His Shop — a man in a red cap and a wide scarlet gown seated at a counter holding up a small pair of scales, gold coins and rings spread out on the wood in front of him, a young man in a tall black hat and a heavy gold chain leaning in over his shoulder beside a woman in green and gold brocade, and shelves behind them crowded with silver vessels, branched coral, rings and strings of beads, all this i will give you, he said, if you will fall down and worship me, away from me, satan, jesus declared, for it is written, worship the lord your god and serve him only
pictures.name: pd_christus_goldsmith

pictures.scene: Bol, The Angel Appearing to Elijah — a fair haired angel in a long white gown with a gold collar and dark tassels standing over a sleeping man in the dark, one hand stretched out toward him and a dark flask carried low in the other, and the old man lying back on his cloak in deep red with his eyes closed, his beard on his breast and one hand open on the ground, then the devil left him, and angels came and ministered to him, when jesus heard that john had been imprisoned, he withdrew to galilee
pictures.name: pd_bol_the_angel_appearing_to_elijah

pictures.scene: Kensett, Lake — a wide still lake lying flat as glass under a soft grey haze, a long wooded mountain coming down to the far shore and a line of dark firs running out into the water at the right, a small wooded island standing alone at the left, and reeds and mossy rock in the shallows in front, leaving nazareth, he went and lived in capernaum, which is by the sea in the region of zebulun and naphtali, to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet isaiah
pictures.name: pd_kensett_lake

pictures.scene: Claude Lorrain, A Seaport at Sunrise — the sun standing low and white over a calm sea and laying a long path of light straight across the water, a square stone fort at the left and tall ships riding at anchor far out, a heavy barge moored in shadow in the foreground, and boatmen in short tunics poling a loaded skiff in to the shore past baulks of timber, land of zebulun and land of naphtali, the way of the sea, beyond the jordan, galilee of the gentiles, the people living in darkness have seen a great light, on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned
pictures.name: pd_claude_lorrain_a_seaport_at_sunrise

pictures.scene: Van Borssom, Nets by Moonlight — a wide dark river at night with the moon showing through the sail of a single fishing boat and laying a long yellow streak across the water, black trees and a far steeple standing against the light, and a line of nets slung from stakes along the near bank with one man in a hat working at them, from that time on jesus began to preach, repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near, as jesus was walking beside the sea of galilee, he saw two brothers, simon called peter and his brother andrew
pictures.name: pd_borssom_netten

pictures.scene: Homer, The Herring Net — a fisherman in dark oilskins and a round hat braced over the side of a dory in a running green sea, hauling in a long net heavy with silver herring that hang shining in the mesh, a second man bent at work behind him and a red barrel buoy riding the swell in front, they were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen, come, follow me, jesus said, and i will make you fishers of men
pictures.name: pd_homer_the_herring_net

pictures.scene: Porcellis, Fishing Boats in Choppy Water — a broad flat bottomed boat running before the wind through short white capped waves under a heavy grey sky, her tall mast bare but for a small red pennant, half a dozen men crowded low along her side at the lines, and a town with a square church tower lying pale along the far shore, and at once they left their nets and followed him, going on from there, he saw two other brothers, james son of zebedee and his brother john, they were in a boat with their father zebedee, mending their nets, jesus called them
pictures.name: pd_porcellis_vissersboten_in_onrustig_water

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Saint Peter Preaching — a white bearded apostle with a gold halo standing barefoot in a pale blue tunic and a deep orange mantle with one hand raised as he speaks, a crowd pressed close on the right with their faces turned up to him, two women kneeling at the front in dark blue and rose and an old man with his head bowed between them, and green wooded hills rising behind, and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him, jesus went throughout galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_saint_peter_preaching

pictures.scene: El Greco, Christ Healing the Blind — a knot of people crowded together on the steps of a pale classical portico, an old bald man with a white beard in grey throwing one arm straight out toward something past the edge of the picture, men in green and brown pressing in behind him, a young man looking out over their shoulders, a woman in rose and blue with a gold skirt turned away at the right, and a wagon and a team of white horses small in the square beyond, news about him spread all over syria, and people brought to him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering acute pain, the demon possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed, and he healed them, the large crowds that followed him came from galilee, the decapolis, jerusalem, judea, and beyond the jordan
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_christ_healing_the_blind

lines.text: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
After fasting forty days and forty nights, He was hungry.
The tempter came to Him and said, If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.
But Jesus answered, It is written: Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.
Then the devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.

If You are the Son of God, he said, throw Yourself down. For it is written: He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.
Jesus replied, It is also written: Do not put the Lord your God to the test.
Again, the devil took Him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
All this I will give You, he said, if You will fall down and worship me.
Away from Me, Satan! Jesus declared. For it is written: Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.
Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him.
When Jesus heard that John had been imprisoned, He withdrew to Galilee.
Leaving Nazareth, He went and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles.
The people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.
From that time on Jesus began to preach, Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.
As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew.
They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
Come, follow Me, Jesus said, and I will make you fishers of men.
And at once they left their nets and followed Him.
Going on from there, He saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets. Jesus called them,
and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed Him.
Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.

News about Him spread all over Syria, and people brought to Him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering acute pain, the demon-possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed, and He healed them.
The large crowds that followed Him came from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
